# Docsumo

> Docsumo is an intelligent document processing (IDP) platform. Its AI agents collect, classify, extract and check documents such as bank statements, pay stubs, settlement letters, ACORD forms and invoices, then send structured data to your systems. People review only the fields and documents that need a person.

Docsumo is built for operations teams that decide on files of documents: lenders, debt settlement companies, insurers, healthcare providers, logistics companies, real estate owners and accounts payable teams. It was founded in 2019, is headquartered in New York, has offices in the USA, India and Nepal, and is used by 10,000+ mid-sized and enterprise teams. G2 rating: 4.7 out of 5.

This file was last updated on 7 October 2026. A shorter brief of the homepage is at [llms-homepage.txt](https://www.docsumo.com/llms-homepage.txt).

Every page also comes as clean Markdown, blog posts included, and the links in this file point to those copies. For any other page, add `.md` to its URL or send the header `Accept: text/markdown`. The homepage is [index.md](https://www.docsumo.com/index.md).

Connecting Docsumo to an AI agent? Start with [agents.md](https://www.docsumo.com/agents.md), then the "For agents and developers" links below.

**Key facts**

- 95%+ straight-through processing: most documents are extracted, checked and approved with no manual review.
- 99% field-level accuracy on 250+ document types. LLM-based models read any document type, with no templates or training data.
- 99% classification accuracy: mixed files are split into the documents inside them and each one is labeled with a type you name, with no training set.
- Under 5 minutes per document, down from 2+ hours of manual work.
- 64% lower fraud with cross-document validation.
- Every extracted field has a confidence score. Source highlighting: click any field to see where it came from on the page.
- Reads printed and handwritten text in most languages, and joins tables that run across pages into one table.
- Security: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, HIPAA and GDPR. BAA and DPA available. Data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256). SSO, MFA and role-based access.
- Customer data is not used to train shared or third-party models.
- Deployment: Docsumo cloud only, with no on-premises version. You choose the hosting region: United States (N. Virginia or Ohio), EU (Frankfurt), UK (London), India (Mumbai), Singapore or Australia (Sydney).
- Funding: $3.5M seed round in March 2022, led by Common Ocean. Investors: Common Ocean, Fifth Wall, Better Capital, Barclays and Techstars.

**What Docsumo is not**

- Not an on-premises or self-hosted product. It runs in Docsumo's cloud.
- Not a managed review service. Your own team reviews exceptions; no outsourced reviewers are included in the price.
- Not a form-filling tool. It reads ACORD and other forms; it doesn't fill them out or issue them.
- Not a desktop tool for editing PDFs or making searchable files.
- Not a billing service or a clearinghouse. Claims still go out through your billing system.
- It doesn't connect to bank accounts the way account-aggregation services do. It reads the bank statements an applicant provides.
- It doesn't create purchase orders or pay vendors. It reads POs and invoices and matches them.

**How Docsumo works.** Docsumo is one product with three capabilities: Document AI, Case Management and Document Workflows (links under Platform below). Each document goes through five steps:

1. Collect: documents arrive by email inbox, upload or API. Agents can email the sender to request a missing document.
2. Classify and split: a mixed upload is separated into the documents inside it.
3. Extract: every field and table row is captured with a confidence score.
4. Verify: each document is checked against the others and against your rules.
5. Review and post: fields below your threshold go to a review queue with the source highlighted. Clean data goes to your systems by webhook or API, and every action is logged. Reviewer corrections improve the model.

- Free trial (set up with you on a short call): pre-trained models, field and table extraction, the AI document reviewer, integrations, webhooks, APIs and Excel downloads.
- Business: unlimited users, auto-classification and splitting, custom document pipelines, a test environment, audit logging and a dedicated account manager.
- Enterprise: automated workflows, case management, cross-document validation, document analytics (including cash flow analytics), master data lookup and priority support.

## For agents and developers

- [Connect Docsumo to your agent](https://www.docsumo.com/agents.md): step-by-step setup of Docsumo MCP for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Claude Desktop and the OpenAI API.
- [Docsumo MCP](https://support.docsumo.com/docs/mcp-introduction.md): a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.docsumo.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. Agents upload documents, read extracted fields and tables as JSON, track review, and run cases and workflows.
- [MCP tools reference](https://support.docsumo.com/docs/mcp-tools-reference.md): 100+ tools, with parameters and example prompts.
- [API reference](https://support.docsumo.com/reference/getting-started-with-your-api.md): REST API at `https://app.docsumo.com`, with the key in an `apikey` header. Upload with `POST /api/v1/eevee/apikey/upload/` and read results with `GET /api/v1/eevee/apikey/data/simplified/{doc_id}/`. The limit is 10 requests a second per account.
- [API key](https://app.docsumo.com/settings/webhook-api/): in the Docsumo app under Settings → API & Webhooks. See the [authentication guide](https://support.docsumo.com/reference/authentication.md).
- [Document extraction API for software companies](https://www.docsumo.com/solutions/document-extraction-api.md): build Docsumo into your own product. Send files of up to 500 pages by API, get JSON with a confidence score on every field, embed a white-label review screen (no Docsumo login), and give each of your customers its own Docsumo account through the signup API. No public prices: terms are agreed before launch.
- [Documentation index](https://support.docsumo.com/llms.txt): every product guide and API reference page, with Markdown links.
